scope: One retained-source HTTP replay per case through the production engine, API and SDK of the checked-out commit. Measures extraction and delivery on saved bytes, not live access, routing or freshness. Each case adds a json format with a schema and a verify contract derived from its task (json_plans.py); the Markdown, tables and links request is otherwise unchanged. K1 variant: list and table cases also send the list format of list_selectors.v1.json, so their records come from the selected items.
verify: Per case: json.status equals complete, every required field present, and the task's records present by index. A success result is status success with verification not failed.
name: dev, json/verify with itemSelector
modelFallback: modelFallback is false on both sides: no extraction model (W2L_EXTRACT_BASE_URL, W2L_EXTRACT_MODEL) is configured where the pair runs, so the deterministic path is measured and F2 (model values kept only where the page states them) is not.
